Background must be genuinely transparent alpha, including all empty space; no background plane, no scenery, no pedestal rectangle, no cast shadow outside the sculpture. No text, no lettering, no UI, no border, no watermarks, no warm tint, no yellow, no gold, no blue, no orange. Preserve sculptural definition so the app can fade the art to 15-30% opacity. New original work, no recognizable modern person.
